summary: Induction on p; in the step, induction over the tensor t_p reduces to the equivariance of single lifts.

steps.claim: Induction on p: for p = 0 both sides are a_0·φ; the step reduces, after unfolding chain₂, to the equivariance of the (p+1)-st pair of lifts applied to the induction hypothesis.

For the pair, induction over the tensor t_p ∈ S_{2p} ⊗ S_{2p+1} (zero, pure tensors s ⊗ s′, sums): for a pure tensor, lift_{k_{2p+1}}(ω(a_{2p+1}, a_{2p+2})s′) ∘ lift_{k_{2p}}(ω(a_{2p}, a_{2p+1})s) sends a_{2p}·ψ to a_{2p+2}·(lift(s′) ∘ lift(s))ψ (Kernel.lift_equivariant, a simp lemma here); sums follow by linearity.
